displayName: 波纹鳍巡游器 Ripplefin Ribbon Scout
description: Original Ripplefin Ribbon Scout is a simplified biomimetic swimming companion with an apricot sensor head, six cream body segments ending in a rounded tail, and two continuous turquoise ribbon fins. Fin-wave propulsion and differential steering are inspired by general engineering principles illustrated by Festo BionicFinWave; this independently drawn palette, rounded topology, blank-card interaction and animation choreography are original design choices, not an official robot, accurate hardware reproduction or popularity claim. Nine states include directional swimming, gentle steering, buoyant ascent and a harmless card-edge light inspection.
author: Cozy Critters Studio
